analysis.headline_cause: Hydraulic hose on excavator EX-02 burst
analysis.reasoning: The foreman states in V01 that the hydraulic hose burst and that three workers cannot continue. That is a first-hand supervisor statement and nothing contradicts it. It explains the immediate trigger only. The GroundWorks email E01 says the routine service was overdue but also says there was no diagnosis of a hydraulic fault, so it is background, not a cause. Why the hose failed, and who is responsible, is not stated anywhere.

hypotheses.statement: Failure due to overdue routine service

external_claims.quote: The routine service on excavator EX-02 is overdue.

gaps: Why the hose failed (wear, damage or missed service) is not stated in any record.
Responsibility for the failure is not established.
